title: Refunds for cancelled or failed orders
text: Refunds for cancelled or failed orders go back to your original payment method within 5 to 10 business days. Refunds to your Zapp wallet are instant. If you don't see a card refund after 10 business days, contact support with your order number.
questions: How long does it take to get my money back for a cancelled order?
When will I see my refund in my original payment method?
What if I don't receive my refund after 10 business days?
Is the refund to my Zapp wallet instant?
